test.description: Single-user mode, started with the settings a tool running OpenL Studio on a developer's machine passes: a file design repository set through the environment, no project creation or deletion, ignored folders. Opening the app auto-authenticates with no login form, and the single user has admin access (Administration menu visible). A project in a nested folder is listed, one in an ignored folder is not, and none can be created, copied or deleted. The project is edited in place: nothing to open, close or save, no revisions, an edit lands in the file, a change of the file on disk is told with Refresh, an edit over it is refused, and Refresh shows the file (EPBDS-16987). The local history keeps the version from disk and restores it, and a workbook and rules.xml changed on disk are told with Refresh.
